comment: She gets a reputation for being tough but she's also one of the most intelligent women I've ever met. If writing isn't your strong suit, I wouldn't necessarily recommend her classes. It's not easy to get good grades on papers, but once she believes you're invested in her class, it seems like she's more lax in her grading.

The class has the potential to be hard. However, if you do the readings/pay attention in class, you'll do fine. Don't go in expecting an easy-A. She definitely makes an effort to break down the tough philosophers and reading, and I certainly understood more about their philosophies after taking the class.
worst teacher I have had at Richmond to date, her grading makes no sense, and teaches you nothing.
TERRIBLE!!!!!!!!!! SHE TEACHES YOU NOTHING AND HAS AN EGO PROBLEM, THINKS BC SHE GRADES HARD SHE IS A GOOD TEACHER, USELESS CLASS AND TEACHER.
